Needs changes before merge.

Reviewed locally after a trial merge with upstream/main `97a880c53e0f8158348410dac152db4ca99f277c`.
The rules are from that main commit. This is a safety-tier review.

What looks good:

- The case has original geometry, an embedded model, and the required catalog files.
- The build script requires verification before it saves or posts.
- I read all 3,635 lines of the new NC golden. The three sections use A90/B0, A-90/B0, and A30/B30.
- No existing NC or CL golden changed. An independent mesh check found closed, consistently oriented edges and no degenerate triangles.

Results on the trial merge:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. The full `example_catalog` suite passed all 22 tests.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- `cargo xtask catalog --check`: PASS for all seven cases.
- Direct load followed by `cam.verify()`: FAIL, exit 1. All three saved operations have status `stale`.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render`, from `crates/ui`: 2 passed, 1 ignored.
- The complete `example_catalog` suite ran through the quick gate. These two suites read the changed catalog case.
- No importer code or STEP fixture changed. The additional kernel STEP suites do not apply.

Heavy test selection:

- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects `app heavy: example_catalog`.
- That suite has zero ignored tests. No release heavy tests ran; this is not a heavy-test pass.

Mutations repeated locally:

- Change the NC Front A90 to A89: the semantic pin fails with `Front pocket posts A90`. Restore the bytes: PASS.
- Change the NC Back A-90 to A-89: the semantic pin fails with `Back pocket posts A-90`. Restore the bytes: PASS.

Requested before merge:

1. `examples/catalog/multiaxis/indexed/indexed.camproj:156` — Rebuild the saved project on current main. Its three stored stamps are obsolete. Loading the committed project and calling `cam.verify()` gives `ok: false` with this diagnostic:

   ```text
   an operation is stale or never generated - regenerate before judging the program
   ```

   The PR body also identifies this pending refresh. The current tests miss it because regeneration replaces the stale caches first. Add a check that each operation has status `Ok` immediately after loading the committed project, before generation. Recheck the NC after the refresh.

Notes:

- The PR changes no UI code, dependency, workflow, or process file.
- The optional compile cache was disabled after its configured directory stalled the initial build.
- No physical machine ran. The fixture and holder limits in the README remain applicable.
- The review mutations were restored. No source change or review evidence was committed to the PR branch.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: The saved indexed project no longer loads with stale operations.

Merged current upstream/main and rebuilt indexed.camproj. The generated NC bytes did not change.
The test catalog_multiaxis_indexed::posts_two_single_axis_indexes_and_one_tilted_pocket checks all three operations for Ok immediately after loading, before generation.

Mutation check: restore the old project, RED with Stale versus Ok; restore the refreshed project, GREEN.
Direct load followed by cam.verify() passes without generation. All three operations report ok.
The catalog NC check passes.

cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main: PASS, 22 tests.
cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings: PASS.

Please re-review this head.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review. All builds and tests ran locally after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `30f30821132facbbafb6d6571af487f600e1880b`.
The laws are from that main commit's AGENTS.md.

What looks good:

- The earlier stale-cache finding is fixed. All three saved operations have status `Ok` immediately after load, before generation.
- Direct load followed by `cam.verify()` passes without generation. The CLI exits 0 and reports all three operations as `ok`.
- The added assertion at `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs:54` detects the earlier stale project.
- The example has original geometry, an embedded model, and the required catalog files. Its script requires verification before saving and posting.
- I checked all 3,635 lines of the new NC golden. The sections use A90/B0, A-90/B0, and A30/B30.
- Every cutting block has finite XYZ values and the expected feed. Its tip stays at or above the 13 mm local floor within output rounding.
- The NC bytes did not change during the project refresh. No existing NC or CL golden changed.
- An independent mesh check found 125 vertices and 246 triangles, with closed, consistently oriented edges and no degenerate triangles.

Local build and test results:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS, 9 steps, 0 failures. The full `example_catalog` suite passed 22 tests.
- The initial gate also selected suites from main because the trial merge was not yet committed locally. All passed: sim lib 199; `hidden_rest_banded` 5, with 1 ignored; `scan_arc` 2; `turned_hidden_rest` 6; app `turning_hidden_floor` 7.
- After the local merge commit, the quick dry-run selects only `example_catalog`. The tested source tree is unchanged.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- `cargo xtask catalog --check`: PASS for all seven cases.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render`, from `crates/ui`: 2 passed, 1 ignored. The ignored test generates screenshots.
- The complete `example_catalog` suite ran through the quick gate. These two suites read the changed catalog case.
- No importer code or STEP fixture changed. The additional kernel STEP suites do not apply.

Heavy lanes:

- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects `app heavy: example_catalog`.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog -- --ignored --list` reports zero tests. No release heavy tests ran; this is not a heavy-test pass.

Mutations repeated locally:

- Change NC Front A90 to A89: RED, `Front pocket posts A90`. Restore the bytes: GREEN.
- Change NC Back A-90 to A-89: RED, `Back pocket posts A-90`. Restore the bytes: GREEN.
- Restore the project from the earlier reviewed head: RED, `Front pocket saved cache`, `Stale` versus `Ok`. Restore the refreshed project: GREEN.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- The PR changes no UI code, dependency, workflow, or process file. Before/after UI screenshots do not apply.
- The PR body's older validation note is superseded by the author's fix comment and these local results.
- The optional compile cache was disabled. Each review build used this worktree's own target directory.
- No physical machine ran. The README states the limits for fixtures, holders, posed stock simulation, and uncut corners.
- All mutation bytes were restored. The review worktree is clean. No review evidence was committed to the PR branch.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
